thread:
incident-bot: PAGING eng-oncall: production p95 latency spike in us-west-2 after release wave-12. Canary showing kernel fallback + batching thrash. Error rate +0.6%. Affected: embed-heavy tenants. Suggested actions: disable `adaptive_microbatch` flag or rollback. @alice (oncall) please triage.
alice (oncall): Ack. Investigating now. @ben (runtime) can you grab canary logs?
ben (runtime): Pulling logs. kernel_selector flip rate >60% to `fallback_slowpath` after microbatch param bump. Not OOMing but scheduler CPU and queue depth high. Seeing batching backpressure.
dana (release): Confirmed wave-12 flipped `adaptive_microbatch=true` and updated kernel selector heuristics. We rolled to ~30% traffic. If kill-switch needed I can toggle.
alice (oncall): Initiating emergency kill-switch for canary: disabling `adaptive_microbatch` for canary hosts. @dana please confirm when set.
dana (release): Toggled off for canary in us-west-2 (done). Monitoring.
ben (runtime): Canary p95 dropped 2400ms -> 600ms within 2m. Errors back to baseline. Prod still elevated on ~10% of nodes that haven't drained yet.
frank (eng-sre): Isolating rollout-tagged slices (wave-12) and draining traffic from updated hosts to speed mitigation.
eve (support_lead): CS: notifying top affected customers. Two have open tickets asking if we have a known issue. No data loss reported.
alice (oncall): Plan: 1) global kill-switch if residual impact persists, 2) drain/evict updated nodes, 3) rollback wave-12 if we can't fully quiesce in 20m. @dana proceed with global flag off?
dana (release): Applying global toggle now... done. Also kicked rollback of wave-12 in parallel. ETA ~12m for full traffic shift.
ben (runtime): Quick RCA notes: new kernel_selector cost heuristic introduced in wave-12 biases to quantized kernel for short sequences. Under the microbatching settings it created contention where the quant path failed back to `fallback_slowpath` frequently, which increased scheduler latency and tail. So the combination of microbatch + heuristic -> pathological fallback loop.
alice (oncall): Logging this in incident tracker. If mitigated we'll hand off to postmortem. If still open in 30m we'll escalate through rotation. @helen (product) can you prep customer comms once we confirm rollback success?
helen (product): On it, drafting initial status and RCA note template.
dana (release): Rollback finished. Metrics show p95 and error rate back to baseline across all regions.
alice (oncall): :white_check_mark: Mitigation confirmed. Follow-ups: add canary perf tests for microbatch+kernel changes, add automated kill-switch when kernel-fallback rate >20% for >2m, and update rollout checklist to include kernel-selector perf sims.
eve (support_lead): Support will follow up with affected customers with status and next steps.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 7654324600. Please file postmortem and tag SRE/runtime/release
